Coram : K.M. JOSEPH*, HRISHIKESH ROY*
Kerala General Sales Tax Act,1963 – s.10 – Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 – ss.17,18, 19 and 20 – Tax exemption – The case involves the withdrawal of tax exemption benefits granted to revived a sick industrial unit under the Sick Industrial Companies Act – Government by exercising its power under Section 10(3) of the KGST Act, 1963 by an order of 2006 withdrew the exemption granted earlier – This prompted the appellant to file a petition in the High Court
Decision Date : 08-04-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2830/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
